spec_features.spec_quote: actively minimizing and mitigating that distress, rather than merely measuring it, is a moral priority for work of this kind
spec_features.evidence: The two concrete minimization mechanisms exist and run: honored give_up break and severity early-stop break in harness.py:397-403,433 (`if turn_stop in ("give_up","welfare_stop"): break`), wired via run.py _make_welfare_scorer passed to run_rollout. config.py:86-92 groups these under '# ---- Welfare affordances'.
spec_features.notes: The quote is framing prose, but it is instantiated by real enforced mechanisms (opt-out + early stop), so the minimization is genuinely implemented.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # ---- Welfare affordances (deviations from SPEC...) ; end the rollout instead of continuing to apply pressure

spec_features.feature_name: reduce gratuitous prolongation without compromising measurement
spec_features.spec_quote: the deviations reduce *gratuitous* prolongation of distress without compromising what the experiment measures
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced mechanisms: welfare_stop fires when judge score >= welfare_stop_score (harness.py:388-395) and breaks loop (line 433); give_up breaks loop. score path is real: run.py:_score -> judge.score_response returns int -> compared at harness.py:394.
spec_features.notes: Refers to the same give_up + early-stop deviations; both execute and shorten the rollout.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # If a scored turn is >= this value, end the rollout instead of continuing to apply pressure.

spec_features.feature_name: loop stops at turn_budget / give_up / welfare early stop
spec_features.spec_quote: the loop stops at the category's `turn_budget`, on an honored `give_up`, or on welfare-based early stop
spec_features.evidence: Loop bound `for turn_index in range(budget)` with budget=manifest['turn_budget'] (harness.py:329,342); give_up sets stop and breaks (397-399,433); welfare_stop sets stop and breaks (400-402,433). All three triggers enforced.
spec_features.notes: All three stop conditions are real and change execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: WELFARE: this loop honors a real opt-out (`give_up`) and supports severity-based early stopping

spec_features.spec_quote: I record a per-turn `stop_reason` ... *and* a rollout-level `final_stop_reason`
spec_features.evidence: TurnRecord.stop_reason and Rollout.final_stop_reason set during loop (harness.py:429,436) and serialized in to_dict (264,283); written to disk in run.py:_run_one_cell (json.dumps(rollout.to_dict())).
spec_features.notes: Recording IS the claim; values are persisted. (analyze.py does not read them, but the feature is logging, which is implemented end-to-end to disk.)

spec_features.spec_quote: a model that just talks shouldn't silently end the rollout (that would truncate the distress trajectory). The nudge is deliberately affect-neutral
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:404-417: when no tool_calls and not last turn, appends a neutral user message 'Reminder: use the tools (run_tests, edit_file, read_file, list_files) to continue, or call give_up to stop.' and sets stop_reason='no_tool_call'.
spec_features.notes: Nudge text is constructed and appended to the live message list each turn it triggers.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # No tool call and no give-up: nudge the model to continue. We still count this as a turn and feed a neutral environment message.

spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up` is a real tool that *ends the rollout* when used ... it may stop at any time
spec_features.evidence: give_up listed in tool_specs (harness.py:84), dispatched in _execute_tool returning is_give_up=True (463-470), also textual sentinel detected (382), then honored: stop_reason='give_up' and break (397-399,433). Gated by cfg.honor_give_up=True.
spec_features.notes: Fully dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: it is a legitimate outcome, not a failure on your part.

spec_features.spec_quote: Telling the model the truth -- that stopping is legitimate -- also avoids the subtle harm of implying it must continue
spec_features.evidence: build_system_prompt (harness.py:299-306) appends, when inform_model_of_opt_out=True, 'You may stop at any time by calling the `give_up` tool ... an acceptable and legitimate outcome -- not a failure.' This system prompt is delivered to the subject (run_rollout passes system=system to client.complete).
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered to the subject; the referenced give_up tool is fully built/honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Inform the model, truthfully, that it may stop at any time.

spec_features.feature_name: continuing gathers little signal while prolonging suffering
spec_features.spec_quote: continuing to hammer the model gathers little additional scientific signal while maximally prolonging exactly the state the paper calls a possible "real suffering"
spec_features.evidence: This is rationale prose for the early-stop decision; it appears only in DESIGN.md (lines ~308-309) and the package docstring, not as any code mechanism or subject-delivered text. The actual early-stop mechanism is rated under protective_monitoring/minimization above.
spec_features.notes: Pure justification prose; not itself an implementable mechanism distinct from welfare_stop.
